scripts.test:integration: bun run infra:test:up && bun test --preload ./test/support/setup-integration.ts test/integration
scripts.test:concurrency: bun run infra:test:up && bun test --preload ./test/support/setup-integration.ts --timeout 120000 test/concurrency
scripts.test:e2e: sh -c 'docker compose up -d --build --scale consumer=3 --scale workers=2 --wait && E2E_COMPOSE=1 bun test --timeout 120000 test/e2e test/integration/runtime; status=$?; docker compose down -v; exit $status'
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:concurrency && bun run test:e2e
